No, that's not true, at least not according to the current data I have (as of 2026-08-17). US passport holders have no visa-free access to Vietnam at all — there's no bilateral or unilateral exemption on record, 45-day or otherwise. So the "US added to the 45-day visa-free list" claim doesn't check out.

What Americans actually need is an e-Visa:
- Up to 90 days stay
- $25 for single-entry, $50 for multiple-entry
- Apply at https://evisa.gov.vn/
- Processing takes 2-3 business days (expedited options exist for more money)
- Valid for entry by air, land, or sea across any of the 83 approved ports — it's not restricted to one nominated port
- Your passport needs at least 180 days of validity remaining from your entry date

Since policy can shift and this is a bundled dataset rather than a live feed, double-check current requirements at evisa.gov.vn before you book anything.
